描述_EN: plain rectangular tables were used for eating, as writing desks or set against a wall for the purpose of displaying flowers or ornaments. a contrasting type of table with set-in legs is known as ‘an’. both categories of chinese table had numerous uses and so cannot be classified by function. a plain wooden table of this type is known as 'zhuo', meaning a table with legs at the corners.
描述_ZN: 普通的长方形桌子被用来吃饭，作为写字台或靠墙摆放，用于展示鲜花或装饰品。 与之相反的一种有桌腿的桌子被称为 "安"。 这两类中国桌子都有很多用途，所以不能按功能分类。 这种类型的普通木桌被称为 "卓"，意思是在四角有腿的桌子。
